# Synthetic Biparental BC2S7 Allele-Frequency Workflow

## Objective

Create a transparent two-founder F1 -> BC2 to parent 1 -> S7 population and
plot final VCF allele frequencies. For a real maize study, replace the synthetic
panel with named founder haplotypes and use a compatible chromosome-10 genetic
map.

## Sequence

Use `F1,BC:P1:2,SELF:7`. With no selection, the expected mean donor allele
fraction after two backcrosses to parent 1 is 1/8. Selfing reduces
heterozygosity but does not alter the expected mean ancestry fraction.

## Reproducible Runner

```bash
Rscript analysis/paper_fig/fig10_biparental_bc2s7_allele_frequency.R \
  --out_dir analysis/results/biparental_bc2s7 --seed 72
```

## Interpretation Boundary

The resulting plot is an implementation and inheritance-pattern check. It is
not a claim about real NAM founders, maize chromosome-10 LD, or breeding
performance without real founders, maps, and validation targets.
